name: The Good Hunter
source:
A retired monster hunter finds himself beset upon by enemies from his past turned suitors, and a potential new threat: his landlord.

[From [url=https://nfreeman.itch.io/the-good-hunter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名退休的怪物猎人发现自己被过去的追求者的敌人以及潜在的新威胁所包围：他的房东。

[来自[url=https://nfreeman.itch.io/the-good-hunter]Itch.io[/url]]
